baselineDisplay.title: Future Champions
baselineDisplay.question: According to the old lesson, what kind of race did the children take part in?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 按照这篇旧课文的叙述，孩子们参加了什么比赛？
baselineDisplay.text:
According to the old lesson, what kind of race did the children take part in?

Editorial note: The following is a revised account of claims made in an old lesson, not a swimming or safety guide; the recording retains the original wording. Evidence does not show that swimming programmes for babies under one year reduce drowning risk, and lessons never replace close adult supervision.
The old lesson described a special swimming pool in Los Angeles where, it claimed, children learned to hold their breath under water before they could walk.
The author wrote that even two-month-old babies did not seem reluctant to enter the water.
The account claimed that the children soon became so accustomed to being in the water that they could pick up weights from the pool floor.
It also described a game called the underwater tricycle race.
In the account, tricycles were lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
The children competed to reach the other end of the pool.
Many pedalled their tricycles, but most preferred to push or drag them.
The author also claimed that some children covered the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
The author wondered whether these children would one day become Olympic champions.
These descriptions are not evidence that such activities are safe or suitable for babies, and readers should not imitate them.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
编者注：以下是对旧课文所述内容的修订性转述，不是游泳或安全指南；录音保留原文。目前没有证据表明，一岁以下婴儿参加游泳课程能够降低溺水风险；课程也永远不能替代成人的近距离看护。
旧课文描述了洛杉矶的一处特殊游泳池，声称那里的孩子还不会走路就学会了在水下屏气。
作者写道，甚至两个月大的婴儿也似乎不抗拒下水。
叙述声称，孩子们很快就适应了水中活动，甚至能够捡起泳池底部的重物。
文中还描述了一种叫作水下三轮车比赛的游戏。
按照文中的描述，三轮车排列在七英尺深的泳池底部。
孩子们比赛谁先到达泳池的另一端。
许多孩子蹬着三轮车，但大多数更喜欢推着或拉着它们。
作者还声称，有些孩子走完泳池全长，甚至一次都没有浮上来换气。
作者猜想，这些孩子将来是否会成为奥运冠军。
这些描述不能证明此类活动对婴儿安全或适宜，读者不应模仿。

display.title: Future Champions
display.question: What kind of race do the children compete in?
display.questionZh: 孩子们参加的是什么样的比赛呢？
display.text:
What kind of race do the children compete in?

Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
display.bodyText:
Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
display.bodyTextZh:
实验已经证明，儿童可以在非常年幼的时候就开始学习游泳。
在洛杉矶的一个特殊游泳池里，孩子们甚至在还不会走路的时候，就已经能够熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。
两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抗拒进入水中。
没过多久，他们就习惯了游泳，甚至能够从泳池底部捡起重物了。
在这些年轻游泳运动员中非常受欢迎的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。
三轮车被整齐地排列在水池底部——那里的水深达七英尺。
孩子们互相比赛，看谁先游到泳池的另一端。
有些孩子骑着三轮车，但大多数更喜欢推着或拉着它们。
有些孩子可以游完全程而一次都不用换气。
他们是否能够成为未来的奥运冠军，只有时间才能告诉我们。
与此同时，他们应该鼓励我们这些游不了五码就气喘吁吁的人。
